solutionSearchEvidence: The current motion core already owns all nine Saasuna profiles, transitions, effects, and reduced-motion behavior; this change forwards figure data-state into that controller.

The current bust-up renderer already maps the touch attribute to TOUCH_CRY, then SAD_DOWNCAST for 1.2 seconds, then the context state. The runtime mount updates motion only during render, so the data-state observer closes the measured integration gap.
